title.narrative: Asian Development Bank - Financing the Blue Economy- SME BlueImpact Asia

description.narrative:
SME BlueImpact Asia is a regional blended finance platform supported by ADB to mobilise investment for small and medium enterprises (SMEs) that support sustainable Blue Economy activities around Asia & the Pacific. The platform aims to develop a pipeline of bankable blue SMEs and aggregate them in portfolios offered to qualified private sector investors. The goal of the pipeline is to leverage catalytic funding from multilateral development banks (MDBs) and development partners. In so doing, the platform will increase the accessibility of ‘blue finance” to SMEs.
Specifically, the project will focus on the corridors of Southern Leyte-Siargao and the Davao Gulf-Pujada Bay of the Philippines. It aims to identify some 5 – 20 SMEs, and to provide them access with up to $5 million debt financing and livelihood and protection for up to 1’000 farmers and workers and their households. Markets supported may include seaweed farming, sustainable fishing and aquaculture, seafood processing, green shipping, and ecotourism. In a subsequent phase, the business cases from this initiative will be replicated and scaled across the area, the nation, and Asia, steadily contributing to closing the $2 trillion blue SME financing gap.
